website.notes: North 2 launched Oct 5, 2026 (Cohere blog, 'North 2: Enterprise AI without compromises'). Single agentic AI platform: new agent harness/orchestration, skills, libraries, memory, applications, automations, connectors (Slack, SharePoint, Outlook, Jira, GitHub, etc.). Deploys privately on-prem, in the cloud, or fully air-gapped (self-hosted, VPC, hybrid, on-prem). North Admin: roles/permissions, granular cost controls, rate limits, user quotas, org-wide caps, token-spend monitoring; 'whether your organization measures adoption or model consumption, Cohere provides the tooling to measure AI ROI.' Post says that over the last year Cohere rolled out North across finance, healthcare, telecom, manufacturing, energy and public sector, 'investing deeply in large-scale production deployments.' Named customers/partners quoted: LG CNS (bringing North to customers across Korea), Bell Cyber; NVIDIA collaboration. SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001. Site nav also lists Private Deployments, Model Vault (isolated inference), Help Center, Customer Stories, industry pages (Financial Services, Public Sector, Technology, Telecom, Energy, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Manufacturing).
